posts.meta_description:
119K likes, 5,016 comments - drewbinsky on October 28, 2021: "October 29th, 2021 at 1:31AM - I just stepped foot in my 197th and final country, Saudi Arabia 🇸🇦💚 

I’m feeling lots of emotions right now and honestly, it’s hard to think straight because I just traveled for 30 hours to get here, but I just want to say one thing - THANK YOU. 

Thank you to my better half @deannasallao for believing in me since I met you 6 years ago. Thank you to my loving parents and my family for supporting. Thank you to all of my best friends for pushing me during the hard times. Thank you to all the strangers and local tour guides I met, in far away places, for keeping me safe and secure.  And most importantly, if you’re reading this, THANK YOU 🙏

I’m feeling extra grateful for each and every one of you for joining me on this wild journey to visit every country in the world. 

Without you, I do not reach this goal.  Without you, I do not have a job.  Without you, I do not know how to express myself.

It has taken me 10 long years (almost exactly to the day) to achieve this goal, since I moved to Prague to study abroad in January 2012.  I was 20 years old back then. Now I am 30.  It’s crazy to think that I’ve been on the road nonstop for the past decade, roughly 3,600 days. 

But thanks to social media, I’m able to share my adventures with the world. And once again, it all comes back to you. Without your comments, questions, advice and words of encouragement, I may have given up during the most challenging days of feeling isolated, anxious and hopeless. 

But I’m here, and even if a pandemic delayed the finish line by 18 months… I did it. I FREAKING DID IT!!!!

You might be wondering ‘What’s Next’ for Drew Binsky? I just posted a YouTube video highlighting my best moments and realizations from visiting all 197 countries, and the end, I share what’s next! It would mean the world to me if you watched (link in bio)- my team and I put a lot of effort into it over the past few weeks. 

For now, its time to sleep 2 hours before a HUGE media day with live interviews scheduled with Bloomberg, CNBC, CNN, ABC, The Today Show, Yahoo! Finance, Channel News Asia, local news stations & many more. 

I LOVE YOU ALL. THIS IS ONLY THE BEGINNING ❤️🚀".

posts.meta_description:
21K likes, 850 comments - drewbinsky on October 10, 2026: "For years, my goal has been simple: inspire you to travel by introducing you to the incredible people and hidden cultures of our world 🌍 And now I’ll be able to reach tens of millions of new people thru Netflix! 

This is truly a full-circle moment for me. Before I ever started my travel blog in 2013, my dream was to have a travel show on Netflix. Over time, that dream faded into the background as I kept writing, filming, and building this online community and my YouTube channel. And then, out of nowhere, Netflix came knocking! 

(Don’t worry, my videos will still be shared on YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, and everywhere else I post them. I am still very much a YouTuber at heart and I always will be)

To anyone holding onto a dream that feels far away: keep going. Sometimes it finds you when you least expect it 🫶🏼".
